development: A 200 kt/yr TDI plant in northwest China has shut for about 25 days of maintenance
context: Chinese operating rates fell six points to 59% the same week. Supply is expected to tighten while it is down, against off-season demand.
internal_note: Isocyanate market letter, issue of 1 July 2026 - the date here is that issue, not the day the plant stopped, which the letter puts earlier in the same week. The letter does not name the plant, so neither does this row

development: A 67 kt/yr TDI plant in India has extended its shutdown to mid-July
context: Third delay to the same turnaround: late May to mid-June, then 1 July, now mid-July. Indian buyers short of domestic material are a call on Chinese export volume.
internal_note: Isocyanate market letter, issue of 1 July 2026

development: A 150 kt/yr TDI plant in Yeosu, South Korea, is to restart after maintenance from 1 June
context: Korean supply returning removes some of the regional tightness that has supported Chinese export prices through June.
internal_note: Isocyanate market letter, issue of 1 July 2026

development: Wanhua Fujian's 360 kt TDI Phase II line is reported on stream since August 2025
context: The largest single addition to Chinese TDI in the period, taking Wanhua's group TDI capacity to about 1.28 Mt. New supply growth stays concentrated in China.
internal_note: EUROPUR FY2025 report, published August 2026 - the date here is that report, the commissioning it describes was August 2025

development: Mitsui is reported to have cut its Omuta, Japan TDI plant from 120 to about 50 kt in July 2025
context: A 70 kt permanent reduction, made on weak Japanese and international supply-demand conditions. Asian capacity leaving the market while Chinese capacity arrives.
internal_note: EUROPUR FY2025 report, published August 2026 - the reduction it describes was July 2025

development: Petroquimica Rio Tercero's 28 kt/yr Argentine TDI unit is reported still closed since October 2024
context: Stopped on poor economics and not restarted since. Latin America is one of the destinations Chinese TDI exports are increasingly directed to.
internal_note: EUROPUR FY2025 report, published August 2026 - production stopped October 2024
